title: I Vibe-Coded My Way Out of Angular Upgrades
why_read: A fairly standard account of using an AI coding assistant to automate a tedious Angular upgrade process, useful mainly as an anecdotal pattern rather than a deep technical insight.
analysis: The author describes creating a custom 'skill' prompt for the Codex AI coding assistant that follows the official Angular upgrade guide, handles migrations, and validates the build. They hit a classic CI pitfall where a local success didn't match a clean CI environment because of a package-lock mismatch, which is a common and instructive gotcha. This is a reasonable real-world example of using AI coding tools for maintenance tasks, but it's a fairly narrow and anecdotal case study rather than a generalizable technical insight.
